deities.name: Hermes
deities.domain: Travelers, shepherds, boundaries, thieves, heralds, trade
deities.description: Swift herald of the immortals and guardian of boundaries, Hermes walks the paths of mortals and shades alike. Travelers pile stones at crossroads in his honor.

deities.name: Athena
deities.domain: Wisdom, tactical warfare, craftsmanship, justice, heroic endeavor
deities.description: Born armor-clad from the brow of Zeus, Athena embodies calculated martial strategy and intellect over brute frenzy.

deities.name: Apollo
deities.domain: Prophecy, music, light, healing, archery, plague
deities.description: Son of Zeus and Leto, Apollo's arrows bring both swift disease and sudden healing. His oracle at Pytho (Delphi) speaks the unbending will of Zeus.

deities.name: Artemis
deities.domain: The untamed wilderness, hunting, wild animals, maidenhood, the moon
deities.description: Twin sister of Apollo, Artemis roams the untamed ridges of Cithaeron and Taygetos with her silver bow and pack of swift hounds.

deities.name: Poseidon
deities.domain: The oceans, storms, earthquakes, freshwater springs, horses
deities.description: The formidable Earth-Shaker whose trident cleaves limestone to summon freshwater springs or shatter islands with tremors. Feared by seafarers and builders alike.

deities.name: Dionysus
deities.domain: Wine, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, theatre, rebirth
deities.description: Born at Thebes of mortal Semele and Zeus, Dionysus brings the divine madness of the vine, shattering mortal pride and releasing souls from dread.

deities.name: Demeter
deities.domain: Agriculture, harvest, fertility of the earth, sacred law, Eleusinian mysteries
deities.description: Goddess of the golden grain and the sacred Eleusinian rites, whose grief for her abducted daughter Persephone plunges the world into barren winter.

deities.name: Hades
deities.domain: The Underworld, the realm of shades, subterranean mineral wealth, funeral rites

primarySources.author: Pausanias
primarySources.passage: Book 6.25.2 (Only temple of Hades at Elis)

deities.description: Ruler of the silent shores of Acheron and Tartarus. Unbending and inexorable, he is not evil, but the just sovereign who ensures no mortal escapes the boundaries of fate.
